summary: Add a labelled scattering apparatus figure and targeted application practice for nuclear evidence, decay balancing, and mass units.

improvements.caption: Alpha-particle source, thin gold foil and movable detector in the scattering experiment
improvements.where: note, after the first paragraph of ## Key ideas
improvements.why: The labelled source, foil, vacuum and detector make the experimental evidence concrete; the diagram table cannot draw this apparatus. The crop is legible and self-contained. Explain that detector readings at different angles reveal mostly straight paths and rare large deflections.
Existing generated short items repeat the same generic answer and do not make the learner connect each distinct scattering observation to its inference.
improvements.what: Add one exam-style structured Explain item with separate marks for mostly undeflected, small-angle and rare backscattered alpha particles, and one misconception-based MCQ on what the experiment cannot establish (neutron composition). Give specific rubrics, explanations and progressive hints.

improvements.why: The worked example only balances a single alpha decay; examiner comments highlight forgetting an incoming neutron and confusing daughter proton-number changes.
improvements.what: Add one Calculate item balancing an incoming neutron in a fission equation, and one multi-step Determine item for the number of alpha and beta-minus emissions in a decay chain. Make learners balance $A$ and $Z$ separately and explain each step.

improvements.where: note, after the existing worked example in ## Method; pack worked and faded example for 9702-11.1.12
improvements.why: The note defines $u$ but never demonstrates its use, while the library gives a nuclear-mass conversion example and the syllabus explicitly requires use of $u$.
improvements.what: Add an approximate mass example: estimate a nucleus mass as $A u$, convert with $1u=1.66\times10^{-27}\,\mathrm{kg}$, and state the approximation because nuclear binding changes the exact mass. Add a distinct faded version for learner practice. Paraphrase the source.
